actions.script: compareError = null let diff = null try { diff = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.dev.DatabaseServices.compare#Schema').parameters({db, entityNames: []}).call() } catch (e) { compareError = String(e.message || e) } if (ec.message.hasError()) { compareError = ec.message.errorsString; ec.message.clearErrors() } checkedCount = diff?.checked || 0 compareErrors = diff?.errors || [] const names = (list) => (list || []).map((item) => item.name || item.column || String(item)).join(', ') const filter = String(context.tableFilter || '').toLowerCase() diffList = ((diff && diff.tables) || []).map((table) => ({ entityName: table.entityName, tableName: table.tableName, missingTable: !!table.missingTable, columns: [table.missingColumns?.length ? 'missing ' + table.missingColumns.join(', ') : '', table.extraColumns?.length ? 'extra ' + table.extraColumns.join(', ') : '', table.columnTypes?.length ? 'type ' + table.columnTypes.map((type) => type.column + ' ' + type.actual + ' (model ' + type.expected + ')').join(', ') : ''] .filter(Boolean).join('; '), indexes: [table.missingIndexes?.length ? 'missing ' + names(table.missingIndexes) : '', table.invalidIndexes?.length ? 'invalid ' + names(table.invalidIndexes) : '', table.extraIndexes?.length ? 'extra ' + names(table.extraIndexes) : ''].filter(Boolean).join('; '), keys: [table.missingForeignKeys?.length ? 'missing ' + names(table.missingForeignKeys) : '', table.extraForeignKeys?.length ? 'extra ' + names(table.extraForeignKeys) : '', table.unindexedForeignKeys?.length ? 'no index ' + names(table.unindexedForeignKeys) : ''].filter(Boolean).join('; '), missingIndexCount: (table.missingIndexes || []).length + (table.invalidIndexes || []).length, missingKeyCount: (table.missingForeignKeys || []).length})) .filter((row) => !filter || (row.tableName + ' ' + row.entityName).toLowerCase().includes(filter)) missingIndexTotal = diffList.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.missingIndexCount, 0) canPlan = ec.user.hasPermission('DATABASE_ADMIN') changeOptions = [{key: 'missingIndexes', text: 'Create missing indexes'}, {key: 'invalidIndexes', text: 'Rebuild invalid indexes'}, {key: 'missingForeignKeys', text: 'Create missing foreign keys'}, {key: 'extraIndexes', text: 'Drop extra indexes'}, {key: 'extraForeignKeys', text: 'Drop extra foreign keys'}, {key: 'dropForeignKeys', text: 'Drop every foreign key'}]
